steps.note: Create an RFQ event for the closed-window scenario.
Use an RFQ stage so the vendor can submit a pricing bid.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add a product so the bid sheet has a line to quote.
Set and commit the bidding window.
Invite one vendor so the vendor portal can access the event.
Publish the event before closing its bidding window.
Confirm the event is published and available for closure.
Wait for the bidding window to lapse naturally, creating the required closed state.
Act from the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the closed event's pricing bid sheet.
Return to the buyer console to verify the event's response count.
Verify no bid was created and the invited vendor remains unresponded.
